title: GoHighLevel AI Studio Pricing 2026: What's Included
description: GoHighLevel AI Studio pricing: what's included with the $50 and $97 AI Employee tiers, what bills at token cost, and how it differs from Agent Studio.
html_content:
Disclosure: GoHighLevel links on this page are affiliate links — I earn a recurring commission of about 40% of the monthly plan fee if you sign up through them, based on the plan you pick, not your usage. Every figure below cites GoHighLevel's own documentation.

GoHighLevel's AI Studio doesn't have its own price tag — its usage is bundled with the AI Employee plans: usage included on the $50/month Growth tier, 3× that included usage on the $97/month Unlimited tier, and token-cost billing on Pay-Per-Use — as of GoHighLevel's published pricing, July 2026. The catch most people miss: AI Studio and Agent Studio are different products with different billing, and the names get used interchangeably. Here's which is which, and what each costs.

Both are part of GoHighLevel's AI lineup — the full AI Employee review covers the whole bundle; this page untangles the Studio pricing.

What is AI Studio in GoHighLevel?

AI Studio (alongside Ask AI) is GoHighLevel's in-platform AI workspace — the assistant layer you use inside the app. Per GoHighLevel's AI Product Pricing doc, its billing rides on your AI Employee tier:

AI Employee tierAsk AI + AI Studio
Pay-Per-Use ($0/mo)Billed at token cost
Growth ($50/mo)Usage included
Unlimited ($97/mo)3× usage included

Two time-sensitive notes from the same doc: Ask AI is free through Summer 2026 as part of GoHighLevel's "Summer of AI" promotion, and — as with every rate on this page — GoHighLevel changes these terms, so check the live doc before budgeting.

How much does GoHighLevel AI cost in total?

If you're pricing "the AI" as a whole, the honest stack as of July 2026 is:

  1. A GoHighLevel plan — $97, $297, or $497 per month.
  2. An AI Employee tier — $0 (pay-per-use), $50 (Growth), or $97 (Unlimited) per month per location, which is where AI Studio usage comes from. The tier-by-tier detail is on the AI Employee pricing page.
  3. Usage that's never bundled — Agent Studio (pay-per-use on all plans) and phone-system charges on every call. Voice-minute economics live on the Voice AI pricing page.

Some AI features cost nothing extra at all: Funnel & Website AI is free at 1,000 prompts/day per location, and Workflow AI is included subject to fair use (its premium actions bill at $0.01 per execution).

AI Studio vs Agent Studio: which one are you paying for?

The naming trips up almost everyone comparing prices:

  • AI Studio — the in-app AI workspace whose usage is included with Growth/Unlimited (table above).
  • Agent Studio — the builder for custom AI agents. It is not included in any subscription — pay-per-use across all plans, billed by model tokens (image generation via DALL-E 3 runs $0.04–$0.12 per image).

So if a review says "AI Studio is included in the $97 plan," it's right about the workspace and wrong if it means the agent builder. Budgeting for custom agents? Read the AI Agent pricing breakdown — that's where the real token math lives.

Is GoHighLevel's AI worth it compared to standalone AI tools?

The included-usage model is the actual argument. A standalone AI chatbot platform bills its own subscription; a team AI-assistant seat is its own per-user monthly fee; a dedicated voice-agent platform meters every minute. GoHighLevel's pitch is that once you're on Growth or Unlimited, the workspace AI (Ask AI + AI Studio), the chat AI, the reviews AI, and the content AI ride along at no additional subscription — you're consolidating four or five AI line items into one add-on that also answers your phone.

The honest counterweight: if you don't want the CRM/marketing platform underneath, you're paying $97–$497/month for a foundation you won't use, and standalone tools win. The AI only makes financial sense as an add-on to a platform you'd run anyway — the full pricing guide lays out that base cost.

Frequently asked questions

How much does GoHighLevel AI cost?

As of July 2026: an AI Employee tier at $0 (pay-per-use), $50/month (Growth), or $97/month (Unlimited) per location, on top of a GoHighLevel plan at $97–$497/month. AI Studio usage is included with Growth and tripled on Unlimited; Agent Studio and phone charges always bill separately.

Is AI Studio free in GoHighLevel?

Its usage is included if you're on AI Employee Growth or Unlimited; on Pay-Per-Use it bills at token cost. Ask AI is free through Summer 2026 under GoHighLevel's promotion.

What's the difference between AI Studio and Agent Studio pricing?

AI Studio usage is bundled with the AI Employee tiers. Agent Studio — the custom agent builder — is never bundled: it's pay-per-use on every plan, billed by model tokens.

Do I need the $97 plan to use AI Studio?

No — Growth at $50/month includes AI Studio usage, and Pay-Per-Use works with no monthly fee at token cost. The $97 Unlimited tier triples the included usage and lifts the voice/chat caps.
